visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on long pieces of dough frying in a deep vat of bubbling oil. The golden-brown items are being submerged by a black wire mesh. (2) Hands pull apart a freshly fried, sugar-coated dough stick, revealing a stretchy, white, mochi-like interior. The background is slightly blurred, showing a street-side food stall. (3) A shot of the food stall's display counter filled with various fried snacks like sesame balls and sweet potato cakes. A person's hand points toward a sign. (4) Sequential close-ups highlight different snacks: a sesame-covered ball being broken open to reveal a peanut filling, a thick sweet potato slice, and a taro-filled pastry. The lighting is bright and natural. (5) A vendor is seen tossing fried vegetables in a metal bowl and sprinkling seasoning powder from a green container. The camera moves in for a close-up of the seasoned vegetable. (6) The final shot shows the storefront with a red sign, a menu, and various equipment. A large text overlay provides the shop's name and address against a street background.
